04

Day by Day

Three bases across seven days, with the driving front-loaded so the middle of the trip stays unhurried.

Wed 2 Sep

PS & W arrive

✈ LUX → ZRH · then on to Winterthur

PS and W fly into Zürich late morning and carry on to Winterthur, so the whole group is together the evening before the drive.

  • Swiss LUX 10:15 → ZRH 11:15 — see the flight panel above.
  • Zürich → Winterthur — around 25 minutes by train from the airport.
  • Evening in Winterthur — pack up and get an early night; tomorrow is the long one.
Thu 3 Sep

Winterthur → Como → Reggio

▾ 5.5 hrs driving · heavy day
  • Winterthur
  • 3 hrsComoLunch and the lake
  • 2.5 hrsReggio EmiliaDinner

The only genuinely long drive. Leaving early makes Como a relaxed lunch stop and still puts you in Reggio Emilia for dinner.

  • Gotthard — check the tunnel queue before committing; the pass road over the top is the better option if traffic has built up.
  • Como — the lakefront and Piazza Cavour are a couple of minutes from the parking; enough for lunch and a proper leg-stretch without losing the afternoon.
  • After Milano — the Po plain runs flat and fast down to Reggio.
Thu 3 – Sat 5 Sep

Fri 4 Sep

Bologna & Modena

▾ 2 hrs 40 driving · loop from base
  • Alle Siepi
  • 1 hrBolognaWalk and lunch
  • 1 hrModena
  • 40 minAlle Siepi

A loop day with no luggage: the big city first while everyone is fresh, then Modena on the way back.

  • Bologna — Piazza Maggiore, the two towers, and 40 km of porticoes. Park outside the ZTL; the centre is a restricted-traffic zone.
  • Modena — smaller and quicker: the Duomo, the Ghirlandina tower and Piazza Grande, all within a few minutes' walk of each other.
  • Timing — back at Alle Siepi by early evening, which keeps the next morning flexible.
Sat 5 Sep

Reggio → Mantova → Lake Garda

▾ 1 hr to Mantova, then north to the lake
  • Alle Siepi
  • 1 hrMantova
  • 40 minBorghettoOptional
  • 30 minLake Garda

A scenic transfer rather than a drive: Mantova's piazzas in the morning, then up to Garda through the Mincio valley.

  • Mantova — Piazza Sordello and Piazza delle Erbe sit next to each other; a couple of hours covers the centre comfortably.
  • Borghetto sul Mincio — a small watermill village on the river, right on the way. Worth the detour if the morning has run to time.
Alternative for this day: swap Mantova and Borghetto for Parma — roughly 45 minutes west of the base, then about 1 hr 45 north to Garda. Same arrival window, a completely different day. Worth settling the night before rather than on the morning.
The south-west shore — where the night will be spent

HILL COLLE — camere & bistrot

CAZZAGO SAN MARTINO · 1 NIGHT · SEP 6 → SEP 7
Planned — ready to book
✓Accommodation selected →Next step: Book

Chosen for the final Italian night, in the vineyards between Garda and Lake Iseo. Not reserved yet. The bistrot on site removes the need to drive anywhere for dinner.

View & Book HILL COLLE ↗ Open in Google Maps ↗
  • Salò — the longest promenade on the west shore, about 20 min from Moniga. A morning walk before leaving the lake.
  • Franciacorta winery — still to arrange. Cellar visits generally need booking a day or two ahead, so worth fixing before the trip rather than on the day.
  • Lake Iseo — about 25 min north of the hotel. Quieter than Garda; drop it if the winery runs long.
Mon 7 Sep

Cazzago → Lugano → Winterthur

▾ 4 hrs driving · back over the Gotthard
  • Cazzago S.M.
  • 2 hrsLuganoBreak
  • 2 hrsWinterthur

Leaving Cazzago late morning puts the group back in Winterthur for the evening, with Lugano as the natural halfway stop.

  • Lugano — lakefront parking and a short walk; enough for lunch without stretching the day.
  • Monday traffic — the Gotthard is usually calmer northbound on a Monday than on a Sunday evening.
Tue 8 Sep

PS & W fly home

✈ ZRH → LUX · 17:45 → 18:40

A late-afternoon flight leaves the whole day free — Winterthur or Zürich, unhurried, before heading to the airport.

  • Swiss ZRH 17:45 → LUX 18:40 — see the flight panel above.
